rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The single provided item (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the required framework and best practices for EV characterization but is insufficient to demonstrate that SGL-001 meets Stage-1 gating criteria. Program-specific CMC, analytical validation, stability/potency correlation, and lot comparability data are missing; confidence that requirements are met is therefore moderate for the guidance and low for program readiness.
findings: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) endorses orthogonal EV characterization, appropriate controls, and transparent reporting but is guidance-level and not program-specific evidence that SGL-001 meets Stage-1 CMC/analytics gates.

No program-specific MCB/WCB documentation, validated intact-EV release and orthogonal QC assay validation reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision), stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint, >=3 GMP-like batch comparability data, or formulation/device compatibility study reports were provided.
Advancing to cross-species PK/PD and formulation comparability testing without the listed CMC/analytics deliverables risks misattribution of biological signals to uncharacterized product variability.
objections: MISEV2023 is a consensus guideline and does not constitute program-specific evidence that SGL-001 meets Stage-1 CMC/analytics or lot-comparability requirements.

There is no provided MCB/WCB creation and characterization, validated intact-EV release assays with LLOQ/specificity/precision, a stability-indicating potency assay with in vivo PD correlation, comparability across >=3 GMP-like batches, or formulation/device compatibility data for SGL-001.
Proceeding directly to cross-species PK/PD and formulation comparability studies without the above deliverables would be premature and increase technical and interpretive risk.

claim_updates.rationale: Only guideline-level evidence provided; no program-specific MCB/WCB, assay validation, potency correlation, or comparability data were supplied.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 meets Stage-1 CMC/analytics requirements for identity, potency, and lot comparability.

claim_updates.rationale: Guidance supports necessary controls but does not replace program-specific CMC and validated assays required to interpret cross-species PK/PD or comparability studies.
claim_updates.statement: Rodent intranasal biodistribution data and guideline citation justify advancing directly into cross-species PK/PD and formulation comparability testing.

claim_updates.rationale: No comparability datasets from >=3 GMP-like batches were provided; the guideline does not constitute evidence of executed, reproducible manufacturing.
claim_updates.statement: Manufacturing scale-up reproducibility and comparability across >=3 GMP-like batches have been demonstrated for SGL-001.

decision_update.question: Should SGL-001 advance into cross-species PK/PD and formulation comparability studies?
decision_update.rationale: Current evidence is limited to guideline-level recommendations (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) without program-specific MCB/WCB, validated release/potency assays, stability/potency correlation, or >=3 GMP-like lot comparability required to de-risk cross-species and comparability studies.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: Label MISEV2023 as guidance only in program dossier. For each submitted dataset, provide a one-line pointer to the specific claim it is intended to support.
proposed_changes.next_action: Require submission of the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package before re-evaluation: (1) MCB and WCB creation and full characterization reports; (2) validated intact-EV release assay(s) and orthogonal QC assay validation reports (fit-for-purpose validation including LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision, robustness) and SOPs used for release testing; (3) a validated, stability-indicating potency assay with data demonstrating correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint relevant to the intended mechanism of action; (4) comparability reports from >=3 GMP-like production runs showing reproducible release specifications, stability profiles, and potency across lots (with statistical comparability analysis); (5) formulation and device compatibility study reports demonstrating intact-EV recovery and stability after formulation and device handling; (6) after submission, convene a human-review panel to approve any advancement.

risk_updates.description: Absence of validated intact-EV release assays, stability-indicating potency assay correlated to in vivo PD, and MCB/WCB documentation increases risk that observed biological effects are due to uncharacterized product variability or assay artifacts.
risk_updates.mitigation: Require validated assay reports, MCB/WCB documentation, and >=3 GMP-like batch comparability before advancing.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient identity/potency characterization

risk_updates.description: Without orthogonal QC and lot comparability, cross-species PK/PD signals may be confounded by formulation, device handling, or lot-to-lot variability.
risk_updates.mitigation: Require formulation/device compatibility studies and demonstrated lot comparability prior to cross-species PK/PD.
risk_updates.title: Interpretation risk for cross-species PK/PD

risk_updates.description: Limited characterization and lack of validated potency correlation reduce confidence that preclinical PD readouts will translate across species.
risk_updates.mitigation: Establish validated potency assay with in vivo PD correlation and include cross-species bridging studies after CMC gaps are closed.
risk_updates.title: Model-to-human efficacy generalizability risk

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not advance SGL-001 into cross-species PK/PD or formulation comparability testing at this time. Require the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package (items listed below) be submitted for re-evaluation. Major advancement decisions require human approval and should remain pending until program-specific data are reviewed.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Current program materials lack demonstrated MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV release assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision), stability-indicating potency assays linked to a PD endpoint, and reproducible release/stability across >=3 GMP-like batches — therefore the program is not ready to advance to cross-species PK/PD or formulation comparability testing.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC and analytics data are missing: (1) MCB/WCB documentation; (2) validated intact-EV release assays with fit-for-purpose validation reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision); (3) stability-indicating potency assay with correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; (4) manufacturing comparability data from >=3 GMP-like batches showing reproducible release/stability/potency.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Without defined MCB/WCB, documented scale-up reproducibility, and orthogonal QC with validated assays, formulation/device compatibility and bridging studies will risk attributing signals to non-EV artifacts or uncharacterized lot-to-lot variability; Stage-1 gating requirements should remain in place until the program supplies the missing CMC/analytics package.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing manufacturing and analytical execution evidence required to de-risk comparability: documented MCB/WCB, scale-up and reproducibility data (>=3 runs), orthogonal QC assay definitions and validations, and formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact-EV recovery.

verification_objections: The program has not produced a Master Cell Bank (MCB) or Working Cell Bank (WCB).
Validated intact‑EV release assays (including LLOQ, specificity, and precision) are absent for the program.
A stability‑indicating potency assay with demonstrated correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint has not been provided.
Comparability demonstrating reproducible release, stability, and potency across ≥3 GMP‑like production batches is lacking.
Formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact‑EV recovery for this program are not available.
